Expansion of Alireza Kaveh’s Scientific Footprint Across International Research Platforms

In a significant step toward strengthening the accessibility and global visibility of his academic work, filmmaker and theorist Alireza Kaveh has expanded his presence across several major international scientific and discovery platforms. These newly integrated profiles help consolidate his research output—from cinema studies and genre theory to interdisciplinary work on artificial intelligence and media—under a unified and traceable scholarly identity.

A number of reputable global databases, including Europe PMC, OpenAIRE, OpenAlex, DataCite Commons, and Virgool Scholar, now index Kaveh’s research contributions, works, and citations. This development ensures that his books, articles, and theoretical projects—such as Film Genre: Tone and Ideology, Cinematic Taxonomy, and AI and Cinema—can be followed and discovered more easily by researchers worldwide.

These platforms complement the core academic profiles already established on Google Scholar and ORCID, expanding the ecosystem through which his works are archived and disseminated. The integration of these new channels marks an important step in creating a comprehensive scholarly network around Kaveh’s research activity.

New Scientific Profiles

Europe PMC OpenAIRE OpenAlex DataCite Commons Virgool Scholar

As these platforms continue to update and ingest new data, Kaveh’s upcoming research, cinematic analyses, and theoretical publications will also be reflected across them. The personal portal AlirezaKaveh.com remains the central hub for all announcements, updates, and official releases.

حضور علیرضا کاوه در پایگاه‌های علمی بین‌المللی

صفحه‌های علمی و پژوهشی علیرضا کاوه در مجموعه‌ای از پایگاه‌های بین‌المللی اکنون به‌صورت یک‌جا و منسجم در دسترس هستند. پژوهشگران، دانشجویان و علاقه‌مندان به نظریه ژانر، تقسیم‌بندی سینمایی و مطالعات میان‌رشته‌ای می‌توانند تازه‌ترین کتاب‌ها، مقاله‌ها و پروژه‌های او را از طریق این پایگاه‌ها دنبال کنند.

این صفحه‌ها به‌تدریج به‌روزرسانی شده و نقش مکملی در کنار درگاه شخصی alirezakaveh.com دارند؛ جایی که انتشار منظم خبرها و آثار انجام می‌شود.
